name: generalized epilepsy-paroxysmal dyskinesia syndrome
description: Generalized epilepsy-paroxysmal dyskinesia syndrome is characterized by the association of paroxysmal dyskinesia and generalized epilepsy (usually absence or generalized tonic-clonic seizures) in the same individual or family. The prevalence is unknown. Analysis in one of the reported families led to the identification of a causative mutation in the KCNMA1 gene (chromosome 10q22), encoding the alpha subunit of the BK channel. Transmission is autosomal dominant.
